### Day 242: Acts 13:1–3
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-242-acts-13-13.html
Passage: Acts 13:1-3
Points:
- The church at Antioch exemplified healthy spiritual community through leaders deeply devoted to God.
- Spending dedicated time in worship and fasting positioned the leaders to hear the Holy Spirit speak.
- God prepares His servants patiently over years before releasing them into specific callings.
- Commissioning Barnabas and Saul marked the launch of pioneering missionary work to spread the gospel.
